payload.title: A JSONSchemaType whose type argument has no named members (any, Record<string, unknown>, an unresolved imported type) is compared as a schema with zero members, so every contract member is reported as a HIGH event_schema_field_drift
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:543-548 (the wire type is checker.getTypeFromTypeNode of the type argument, with no check that it has named properties)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:551-562 (memberOptionality reads checker.getPropertiesOfType, which is empty for any, an index-signature type and an error type)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:565-576 (compareMembers puts every contract member into contractOnly when the wire map is empty)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-adapter.ts:471-482 (any non-empty contractOnly becomes a severity high event_schema_field_drift finding)
tools/aria-adapters/event-contracts-schema-agreement.test.ts:334-362 (no near-miss scenario types a wire as any, Record or an unresolved import)
payload.rule_violated: Z27 design: a drift finding states that two named member sets disagree; an unreadable wire type is an unresolved input, not an empty set. A HIGH finding whose premise (the wire has no such member) is false misleads the judge.
payload.notes: A schema typed `JSONSchemaType<Record<string, unknown>>`, `JSONSchemaType<any>` or `JSONSchemaType<Imported>` where `Imported` does not resolve inside the contained program is paired with its contract and produces one HIGH event_schema_field_drift listing all contract members as 'only in the contract'. Reproduced by running the verbatim typedWireSchema, memberOptionality and compareMembers on a TankDeletedEvent with tankId, deletedAt and note?: for each of the three wire types the result was contractOnly [deletedAt, note, tankId] and no wire members. Not present on clean main (0 findings); a developer introduces it with one edit. Close condition: Treat a wire type with no property symbols, an index signature, any or an error type as unresolved (no drift finding, an unresolved observation), and add scenarios for `JSONSchemaType<any>`, `JSONSchemaType<Record<string, unknown>>` and an unresolvable import asserting no event_schema_field_drift. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 1). Verified at head a47dc4d57c of open pull request #2134; the cited code is not on main until that pull request merges.
